question:
In the given figure, ΔQPS ≅ ΔSRQ. Find the measure of ∠PSR. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/375427cdd0d5ccb945898cdc727e87205e84528b84d3e85ea85e7dcede4b0e38.png]
solution:
Given

ΔQPS ≅ ΔSRQ

Concept used

Congruency: Two triangles are said to be congruent if they have all their corresponding sides and angles equal to each other

Calculation

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/375427cdd0d5ccb945898cdc727e87205e84528b84d3e85ea85e7dcede4b0e38.png] 

According to the question,

∠P = ∠R

 

⇒ 106 = 2x + 12

 

⇒ 2x = 94

 

⇒ x = 94/2 = 47

 

∠QSR = 180 - 52 - 106 = 22

 

∠PSQ = ∠SQR = 52

 

∠S = 52 + 22 = 74°

 

**The answer is 74°.**
